_comment: signal_modulation/design03_realscale — design01's Nd:YAG amplifier rebuilt at REAL DOPING and fabricable scale, for the amplitude/saturation calibration. Created 2026-09-04 (user: 'Set it up. We will run it on lips. Amp sweep first.'). WHY A NEW NUMBER: design01a-d were one device measured four ways, so they shared letters; this changes the crystal itself (doping and length), which by the 2026-09-03 convention earns a number. 02 stays reserved for the pump-modulation experiment the design01 JSON names. WHAT CHANGED FROM design01, and only these: (1) SGMA 1.86e-5 -> 6.2e-7, the LITERAL 1 at.% Nd:YAG value — verified, not assumed: real alpha = sigma_em*N = 2.8e-19*1.38e20 = 38.6 /cm = 3.864e-3 /um, and back-solving design01's own calibration alpha = 1.1*SGMA*N3_0*(0.1/gamma) at N3_0=30, gamma 5.3e-4 gives 6.206e-7, matching the JSON's 6.2e-7 to 0.1%. (2) crystal 20 -> 600 um, which is exactly the 30x that keeps gL = 2.32 unchanged, so every gain number stays comparable to design01. (3) transverse scale x sqrt(30) = 5.48: guide 5 -> 27.5 um. The sqrt is not a typo — mixing length goes as w*p (L_mix = pi*n*w*p/lam), so a 30x longer device needs only sqrt(30) larger transverse features to keep the SAME diffraction geometry. That preserves design01d's L/L_mix = 1.49 exactly, which is the whole point: if CROSS survives here, it survives because the physics scaled, not because the geometry was re-tuned. NOTE this corrects the '10 um strips at 25 um pitch' quoted on Discord before the arithmetic was done — that pair has L_mix = 1343 um and belongs to a 1.9 mm crystal, not a 600 um one. Everything else — n 1.82, background 1.77, lbdA/lbdE, the REAL linewidths (gammaE 5.3e-4 = 159 GHz, matching Nd:YAG's 0.6 nm FWHM at 1064; gammaA 1.5e-3 = 450 GHz), N3_0 30, rate_43/rate_21, pump amplitude 50 — is byte-identical to design01 so the comparison is clean. THIS FOLDER IS THE design01 ANALOGUE: full-aperture source, one drive, amplitude sweep only. The two-strip analogue of design01d is design03b_strips, which must reuse this exact device block plus strips w=5.48 at y=+-6.85 (pitch 13.69). RUN LONGER THAN design01: transit is now 602*1.82 = 1096 t.u. instead of 36, and the burn is 30x slower per unit intensity because SGMA is 30x smaller, so run_until 10000 with the DFT window opening at 6000. dft_t_end == run_until deliberately — an explicit dft_t_end below run_until silently terminates the run there. AMPLITUDE LADDER: stimulated rate goes as SGMA*I, so 30x smaller SGMA needs 30x the intensity for the same saturation = sqrt(30) = 5.48x the FIELD amplitude. design01's knee sat between amp 10 and 100 with a ceiling near 80 (100 gave negative populations), so expect the knee near 55-550 and the ceiling near 440 here; the ladder in scripts/slurm_sigmod03_lips.sh brackets that. DO NOT read watts off the amp axis — MEEP amplitude is normalized and depends on source geometry; the physical bridge is stored energy (N3_0=30 <-> 25.8 J/cm3 = full inversion of 1 at.% Nd:YAG).

guide_1._comment: input stub, 27.5 um tall = design01's 5 um x sqrt(30). n step 1.82/1.77 gives NA 0.42 (acceptance 25 deg), same as design01 — the strips in design03b will overrun it and bounce, exactly as the 1 um strips did in design01d (footprint/half-width ratio 2.19 in both).

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG at LITERAL 1 at.% doping. SGMA 6.2e-7 x N3_0 30 over 600 um -> gL = 2.32, identical to design01's scaled-doping gL. Population grid resolution stays 10.

sted._comment: Starts fully inverted (N3_0=30, N1_0=0), same justification as design01: 230 us storage means a pre-pumped crystal simply IS full when a ps-scale signal arrives, and 230 us = 7e10 t.u. is unreachable in-sim, so the upper level effectively does not decay over the run. Consequence for reading the sweep: saturation here is a FINITE STORED INVERSION being burned, not a steady-state tau balance. The real I_sat = h*nu/(sigma_em*tau) = 2.9 kW/cm2 comes from real constants, NOT from this axis.

source_1._comment: CW 1064 nm signal, Ey, full aperture — the design01 analogue. Full aperture on purpose: this folder measures the saturation curve, and a full-aperture drive removes transverse diffraction so the amp axis is a pure drive axis. Local intensity for a given amplitude is aperture-independent, so the ladder calibrated here transfers to the narrow strips of design03b. Amplitude is overridden per task by run.py --signal-amp.

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump entering from above, y-normal sheet along the whole 600 um top edge. Ez, orthogonal to the Ey signal so they never interfere directly; the crystal is isotropic so the pump still drives 1->4. Amplitude 50 unchanged from design01 — the sheet is 30x longer but the per-unit-length pump intensity is the same, so the local refill rate matches.

monitor_1._comment: input reference line. Sensors kept deliberately minimal (two 1Ddft lines + one point): a 10000 t.u. run on a 606x32 um cell with line snapshots or population dumps would be many GB per task.

monitor_2._comment: output line. monitor_2/monitor_1 at 1.064 is the single-pass gain.

snap_point._comment: exit time trace — this is what the pilot is really for: the envelope flattening time sets dft_t_start for the production sweep. If it has not flattened by 6000, raise run_until before trusting any gain number.
